senses.en: to keep something in the mind, or to bring it back

ex.en: Remember to lock the lab door.
ex.zh: 记得锁实验室的门。

ex.en: Communities remember a flood longer than planners do if their homes were under water.
ex.zh: 如果自家被水淹过，社区对洪水的记忆会比规划者更久。

tip: remember to do 是记得要做；remember doing 是记得做过。

senses.en: an amount of something available to use
to provide something that is needed

ex.en: The water supply was cut for two hours.
ex.zh: 供水中断了两个小时。

ex.en: A steady supply of books matters more to a village school than one expensive set of posters.
ex.zh: 对乡村学校来说，稳定的图书供应比一套昂贵的海报更重要。

tip: supply 作动词时，说 supply somebody with something。

senses.en: to touch someone with the lips to show love or greeting

ex.en: She kissed her grandmother at the gate.
ex.zh: 她在门口吻别祖母。

ex.en: A story can mention a kiss and still be about saying goodbye, not about a lesson in romance.
ex.zh: 故事可以提到一个吻，主题仍然是告别，而不是恋爱课。

tip: kiss 也可作名词。本条用家庭告别的普通含义。

ex.en: The health class uses the word abortion as a medical term.
ex.zh: 健康课把 abortion 用作医学术语。

ex.en: A clinic should explain the word abortion without pressure or instructions.
ex.zh: 诊所应当解释这个词，而不施加压力，也不给做法。

tip: 本条是健康词汇。不写过程。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping

ex.en: I wake at six on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我六点醒来。

ex.en: Street noise can wake a child long before the alarm that was meant to do it.
ex.zh: 街上的噪音可能在闹钟之前就把孩子吵醒。

tip: wake 的过去式是 woke，过去分词是 woken。叫醒也常说 wake somebody up。

senses.en: the liquid from fruit or vegetables

ex.en: The juice is mostly sugar.
ex.zh: 这果汁主要是糖。

ex.en: Juice that hides the sugar should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 隐瞒含糖量的果汁应当在标签上写明。

col: a glass of juice｜一杯果汁
tip: juice 作物质名词通常不可数。

senses.en: an empty area, or the area beyond Earth

ex.en: There is no space left on the notice board.
ex.zh: 布告栏上没有空位了。

ex.en: Cities that leave no space for trees make summer streets hotter for people who walk.
ex.zh: 不给树留空间的城市，会让步行的人觉得夏天的街道更热。

tip: space 表示空间时常不可数；一个空位用 a space。

senses.en: used to show surprise or understanding

ex.en: Oh, I left my pen in the lab.
ex.zh: 哦，我把笔落在实验室了。

ex.en: Oh is a small word, but in a dialogue it can show surprise, pain, or a sudden idea.
ex.zh: Oh 是个小词，但在对话里可以表示惊讶、疼痛或忽然想到。

tip: oh 是感叹词，后面常用逗号。

senses.en: the spiritual part of a person, or a deep feeling

ex.en: The song seemed to come from the soul.
ex.zh: 这首歌仿佛发自心灵。

ex.en: Not a soul was in the library at dawn, but the lights had been left on.
ex.zh: 黎明时图书馆里一个人也没有，灯却还亮着。

col: not a soul｜一个人也没有
tip: not a soul 表示一个人也没有。soul 在宗教和文学里很常见。

senses.en: an act of asking for something politely

ex.en: She made a request for a quieter room.
ex.zh: 她请求换一间更安静的房间。

ex.en: A written request is easier for a school office to track than a remark in the hallway.
ex.zh: 书面请求比走廊里的一句话更容易被学校办公室跟上。

col: at the request of｜应……的请求
request sb to do｜请求某人做
tip: request 比 ask 正式。

ex.en: The teachers are at a conference today.
ex.zh: 老师们今天在开会。

ex.en: A conference about rural schools should include a teacher who actually works in one.
ex.zh: 关于乡村学校的会议，应该包括一位真正在那里工作的老师。

tip: conference 通常比 meeting 更正式、规模更大。

ex.en: The farm is 2 km from school.
ex.zh: 农场离学校 2 千米。

ex.en: A map that uses km without a scale still leaves the reader guessing.
ex.zh: 不用比例尺却用千米的地图，仍然让读者猜。

tip: km 是 kilometre 的缩写。数字和 km 之间通常留空格。表里没有单独一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a large natural stream of water

ex.en: The river behind the school rose after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后学校后面的河上涨了。

ex.en: A clean river is a shared good; waste from one factory reaches every town downstream.
ex.zh: 干净的河是共同的好处；一家工厂的废物会到达下游每个城镇。

tip: river 是可数名词。

senses.en: a person admired for courage, or the main male character

ex.en: The hero of the story is a bus driver.
ex.zh: 故事的主人公是一位公交司机。

ex.en: Calling every winner a hero can hide the teammate who passed the ball.
ex.zh: 把每个获胜者都叫做英雄，可能掩盖那个把球传出来的队友。

tip: 复数是 heroes。女英雄常用 heroine。

senses.en: a large animal used for riding or farm work

ex.en: The horse stood still by the gate.
ex.zh: 马静静地站在门口。

ex.en: A school that keeps a horse needs a plan for holidays, not only a photo on open day.
ex.zh: 养马的学校需要假期的方案，而不只是开放日的一张照片。

tip: horse 可数。骑马常用 ride a horse。

senses.en: the meal in the middle of the day

ex.en: Lunch is at twelve in the hall.
ex.zh: 午饭十二点在食堂。

ex.en: A free lunch helps the student who would otherwise skip the meal.
ex.zh: 免费午餐能帮助那些否则会不吃饭的学生。

tip: lunch 前通常不用 a，除非指一份具体的午餐。

senses.en: from one end towards the other

ex.en: We walked along the river after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我们沿着河走。

ex.en: Shops along the road to school decide what students can buy on the way home.
ex.zh: 通往学校的路上的商店，决定了学生回家时能买到什么。

tip: along 强调沿着一条线走；across 是从一边到另一边。

ex.en: The shelf is too tall for the first row.
ex.zh: 架子对第一排来说太高了。

ex.en: A tall sign that nobody can read at night is not a safety plan.
ex.zh: 夜里没人读得清的高牌子，不是安全方案。

tip: 人的身高用 tall。high 多用于物。height 是本批的名词。

ex.en: Whom did you ask for the key?
ex.zh: 你向谁要的钥匙？

ex.en: In formal writing, whom follows a preposition: the teacher to whom I wrote.
ex.zh: 正式写作里，whom 跟在介词后，例如 the teacher to whom I wrote。

tip: 口语里多用 who。介词后面的正式文体仍用 whom。

senses.en: under, or in a lower position

ex.en: The key is beneath the book.
ex.zh: 钥匙在书下面。

ex.en: Beneath the poster, the real time is written in pencil.
ex.zh: 海报下面，真实时间用铅笔写着。

tip: beneath 比 under 更正式，也可作副词。

ex.en: Read the next chapter before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前读下一章。

ex.en: The last chapter of a report should say what the school will actually do.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一章应当写学校实际上会做什么。

tip: chapter 可数。书的章用 chapter，文章的段用 paragraph。

ex.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在钩子上。

ex.en: A spare coat at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first one.
ex.zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用外套就有用。

tip: coat 也可指一层涂层。

senses.en: to accept something painful, or to carry a weight

ex.en: I cannot bear the noise in the hall.
ex.zh: 我受不了大厅里的噪音。

ex.en: The bridge can bear the weight of a bus, according to the sign.
ex.zh: 根据标牌，这座桥能承受一辆公交的重量。

tip: 忍受的过去式是 bore，过去分词是 borne。出生用 be born。名词 bear 是熊。

ex.en: The medal looks like gold.
ex.zh: 这块奖牌看起来像金子。

ex.en: A gold mine can bring wages and also leave a river too dirty to drink.
ex.zh: 金矿能带来工资，也会把河弄脏到不能喝。

tip: gold 作定语常表示材料：a gold ring。golden 多表示金色或珍贵。

senses.en: to make something more modern or add new information
new information, or a newer version

ex.en: Please update the class list.
ex.zh: 请更新班级名单。

ex.en: Schools should update an emergency number on the wall the day it changes.
ex.zh: 紧急电话一变，学校就应当当天改墙上的号码。

col: update sb on｜向某人更新情况
tip: update 也可作名词。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

ex.en: The team has training on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 球队周三训练。

ex.en: Training for village teachers fails if it takes them away from class for a whole month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训让他们离开课堂整整一个月，培训就会失败。

tip: training 通常不可数。

senses.en: To bring things together in one place or direct efforts there.
A substance made stronger by removing water or other material.

ex.en: It is hard to concentrate in a noisy room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂的房间里很难集中注意力。

ex.en: Governments should concentrate resources on preventive healthcare to reduce pressure on hospitals in the long term.
ex.zh: 政府应将资源集中于预防性医疗，以长期减轻医院的压力。

col: concentrate on a task｜专注于任务
concentrate resources on｜将资源集中于
tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。

senses.en: the food a person usually eats

ex.en: A balanced diet includes fruit.
ex.zh: 均衡的饮食包括水果。

ex.en: The canteen diet should be one a student can see and afford.
ex.zh: 食堂的饮食应当是学生看得见、也买得起的。

tip: diet 可数。on a diet 表示节食。表里这一行的音标是 die，本库不用。

senses.en: a person who is not in the armed forces

ex.en: The report names civilians, not only soldiers.
ex.zh: 报道写出平民，而不只是士兵。

ex.en: A history text should say what happened to civilians.
ex.zh: 历史课文应当说平民遭遇了什么。

tip: civilian 也可作形容词。本条是历史和社会词汇。

ex.en: The tube in the lab is labelled.
ex.zh: 实验室里的管子贴了标签。

ex.en: A tube without a label should not be used.
ex.zh: 没有标签的管子不应当使用。

tip: 英式 the Tube 可指伦敦地铁。本条以管子为主。

ex.en: The early bus is fast, but it is often full.
ex.zh: 早班车很快，但常常满员。

ex.en: A fast road into the city helps drivers and can make the walk to school more dangerous.
ex.zh: 进城的快速路方便司机，也可能让走路上学更危险。

tip: fast 既可作形容词也可作副词，不加 -ly。fast 作副词不是 fastly。

senses.en: a machine that carries people or goods

ex.en: No vehicle may enter the playground.
ex.zh: 任何车辆不得进入操场。

ex.en: An electric vehicle still needs a safe place to charge near the school.
ex.zh: 电动车仍然需要学校附近一个安全的充电处。

tip: vehicle 是车辆的总称，包括汽车、公交和自行车在正式用语里有时也包括。

senses.en: a large organised group of soldiers

ex.en: The history book describes the army's long march.
ex.zh: 历史书写到军队的长途行军。

ex.en: An army can build a bridge quickly, but a town still needs people to maintain it.
ex.zh: 军队可以很快建起一座桥，但城镇仍需要人来维护它。

tip: army 作整体时谓语可用单数。

ex.en: The broken window was repaired before class.
ex.zh: 破碎的窗户在上课前修好了。

ex.en: A broken lift in a station matters most to travellers who cannot use the stairs.
ex.zh: 车站里坏掉的电梯，对不能走楼梯的旅客影响最大。

tip: broken 是 break 的过去分词，也可作形容词。

senses.en: work, especially physical work; American spelling

ex.en: The harvest needs extra labor in October.
ex.zh: 十月的收成需要额外的劳力。

ex.en: Fair labor rules matter when students take a weekend job to pay for books.
ex.zh: 学生周末打工买书时，公平的劳动规则就很重要。

tip: labor 是美式拼写，labour 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

ex.en: The path goes through a forest.
ex.zh: 这条小路穿过一片森林。

ex.en: A forest near a town cools the air and still needs a rule against leaving rubbish.
ex.zh: 城镇附近的森林能让空气变凉，也仍然需要禁止丢垃圾的规定。

tip: forest 比 wood 大。a forest，the forest 都可以。

ex.en: The library will expand the reading room.
ex.zh: 图书馆将扩大阅览室。

ex.en: Cities expand bus routes when they count who is left at the stop.
ex.zh: 当城市数清还留在车站的人时，才会延长公交线路。

tip: expand 可及物也可不及物。

senses.en: something people do, especially for a purpose

ex.en: The club plans one outdoor activity a month.
ex.zh: 社团每月安排一次户外活动。

ex.en: After-school activity should not depend only on families who can pay for extra lessons.
ex.zh: 课外活动不该只依靠付得起额外课程的家庭。

col: take part in an activity｜参加活动
tip: activity 表示具体活动时可数。不可数时指活跃或繁忙。

senses.en: not shaking, or continuing at the same rate

ex.en: Keep a steady pace.
ex.zh: 保持平稳的步速。

ex.en: A steady bus is more useful than a poster of a new one.
ex.zh: 稳定的公交比一张新车海报更有用。

tip: steady 也可作动词“使稳定”。

senses.en: a duty to deal with something

ex.en: It is your responsibility to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 锁实验室是你的责任。

ex.en: Responsibility for a flooded street is shared by the town, not only by the family on the ground floor.
ex.zh: 被淹街道的责任在城镇，而不只在一楼那户人家。

tip: 对某事负责：be responsible for。

senses.en: a place larger than a village and smaller than a city

ex.en: Our town has one public library.
ex.zh: 我们镇上有一座公共图书馆。

ex.en: A small town loses young people when the college, the jobs, and the buses are all in the city.
ex.zh: 当大学、工作和公交都在城里时，小镇会失去年轻人。

tip: town 比 city 小。in town 常不加 the。

senses.en: a natural place far from towns

ex.en: Wild birds nest in the trees by the river.
ex.zh: 野鸟在河边的树上筑巢。

ex.en: A wild hillside above a town can become a park, or it can become the next row of houses.
ex.zh: 城镇上方的荒坡可以变成公园，也可以变成下一排房子。

tip: in the wild 表示在野外。wild 也可作名词“荒野”。

senses.en: the place you are going to

ex.en: The destination is on the ticket.
ex.zh: 目的地写在票上。

ex.en: A destination without a return time is not a plan.
ex.zh: 没有返回时间的目的地不是计划。

tip: destination 可数。

ex.en: He finished the paper without a single mistake.
ex.zh: 他交卷时一个错误都没有。

ex.en: A city cannot cut car use without giving people buses and pavements they can trust.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公交和人行道，一座城市就无法减少私家车使用。

tip: without 后接名词或 doing，不接 to do。

ex.en: My dad picks me up on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我爸爸周五来接我。

ex.en: A dad who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的爸爸可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: dad 是口语；正式写作可用 father。

senses.en: related to society or to meeting people

ex.en: We did a social study on how neighbours share tools.
ex.zh: 我们做了一项关于邻居如何共用工具的社会调查。

ex.en: Social media can connect a class, but it can also spread a rumour in minutes.
ex.zh: 社交媒体能把一个班联系起来，也能在几分钟内传播谣言。

tip: social 是形容词；社会用 society。

senses.en: a single part, or a standard of measurement

ex.en: We finished unit three today.
ex.zh: 我们今天学完了第三单元。

ex.en: A small clinic is a useful unit of care when the hospital is an hour away.
ex.zh: 当医院在一小时之外时，小诊所是有用的医疗单位。

tip: unit 是可数名词。

ex.en: The speech was short but powerful.
ex.zh: 这次发言很短，但很有力量。

ex.en: A powerful poster can change a habit only if the school also changes the choice in the canteen.
ex.zh: 有力的海报只有在学校同时改变食堂的选择时，才可能改变习惯。

tip: powerful 可形容人、机器、话语或效果。

senses.en: an opening or a hollow place

ex.en: There is a hole in the fence.
ex.zh: 篱笆上有一个洞。

ex.en: A hole in the playground should be marked before the first class, not after someone falls.
ex.zh: 操场上的坑应当在第一节课之前标出来，而不是等有人摔倒之后。

tip: hole 可数。in the hole 有时比喻亏空。

senses.en: to find the size or amount
an action, or a unit of size

ex.en: Measure the table before you buy the cloth.
ex.zh: 买布之前先量桌子。

ex.en: Cities should measure the air near schools, not only in the park.
ex.zh: 城市应当测量学校附近的空气，而不只是公园里的。

tip: measure 作名词是措施或度量。take measures to do 表示采取措施。

ex.en: Draw a picture of your street.
ex.zh: 画一张你的街道。

ex.en: A picture of a clean river can hide the factory that still pours waste at night.
ex.zh: 一张干净河流的照片，可以藏起仍在夜里排污的工厂。

tip: picture 作动词是“想象”。

senses.en: an early version of a piece of writing

ex.en: Hand in a draft before the final essay.
ex.zh: 交定稿前先交一份草稿。

ex.en: A draft budget lets parents see the numbers before they are locked.
ex.zh: 预算草案让家长在数字定死之前看见它们。

tip: draft 作动词是起草。美式 draft 也可指征兵，本条以草稿为主。

ex.en: Our target is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A target that ignores poorer schools can make a city average look successful and still leave them behind.
ex.zh: 忽视较穷学校的目标，可以让城市平均数看起来成功，那些学校却仍被落下。

tip: target 作动词是“以……为目标”。

ex.en: Every child in the class has a reading book.
ex.zh: 班上每个孩子都有一本读物。

ex.en: A child who walks to school needs a pavement, not only a parent with a car.
ex.zh: 走路上学的孩子需要人行道，而不只是一位有车的家长。

tip: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs。

ex.en: What kind of book do you like?
ex.zh: 你喜欢哪一类书？

ex.en: The kind of food sold at a school gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
ex.zh: 校门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。

tip: kind 作形容词是“善良的”：be kind to sb。

senses.en: of the sun, or using its energy

ex.en: The solar clock in the yard still works.
ex.zh: 院子里的太阳钟还能用。

ex.en: Solar power on a school roof helps only if someone can repair it.
ex.zh: 学校屋顶的太阳能只有在有人能修的时候才有帮助。

tip: solar 是形容词。名词太阳是 the sun。

senses.en: a stamp used to close something, or a sea animal

ex.en: The seal on the letter is broken.
ex.zh: 信上的封缄破了。

ex.en: The nature book shows a seal, and the lab door has a different seal.
ex.zh: 自然课本里是海豹，实验室门上是另一种封条。

tip: 印章和海豹同音。作动词是密封。本条不写如何伤害动物。

senses.en: a way of entering or using
A way of reaching or entering a place.
Reach, enter, or obtain something, especially information on a computer.

ex.en: Students need access to the library.
ex.zh: 学生需要使用图书馆的权限。

ex.en: Affordable internet access enables rural students to benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的互联网接入能让农村学生受益于更丰富的教育资源。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
gain access to｜获得使用或进入的机会
tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。

ex.en: The club helps students find their potential.
ex.zh: 社团帮助学生发现自己的潜力。

ex.en: The potential of an empty building is a clinic or a library, if the town chooses that use.
ex.zh: 一座空楼的潜力是诊所或图书馆，如果城镇选择那样使用。

tip: potential 也可作形容词“潜在的”。

ex.en: The agricultural show is in October.
ex.zh: 农业展览在十月。

ex.en: Agricultural work feeds the town, and the workers need the bus too.
ex.zh: 农活养活城镇，干活的人也需要公交。

tip: 名词 agriculture 是本批的另一词。

ex.en: Unlike the morning bus, the later one stops here.
ex.zh: 和早班车不同，晚班车在这里停。

ex.en: Unlike a poster, a working clock tells you whether you are late.
ex.zh: 和海报不同，一块能走的钟会告诉你是否迟到了。

tip: unlike 是介词。形容词 unlike 表示不同的，较少用。

senses.en: A reason or set of reasons supporting an opinion.

ex.en: Their argument lasted for hours.
ex.zh: 他们的争论持续了几个小时。

ex.en: The strongest argument for public transport investment is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 支持投资公共交通最有力的论据是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

col: a convincing argument｜有说服力的论据
tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

ex.en: The lab rule is to wear glasses.
ex.zh: 实验室的规则是戴眼镜。

ex.en: A rule against litter works when bins are near and everyone can see it applied.
ex.zh: 当附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都看到规则被执行时，禁止乱扔的规则才有效。

tip: rule 作动词是“统治”。

senses.en: a tool with hairs used for cleaning or painting
to clean or paint with a brush

ex.en: The brush is by the sink.
ex.zh: 刷子在水槽边。

ex.en: A brush in the art room should be washed the same day.
ex.zh: 美术室的刷子应当当天洗。

tip: brush 作动词是刷。

senses.en: feeling pleased about something you or others did

ex.en: Her parents are proud of her speech.
ex.zh: 她父母为她的演讲感到自豪。

ex.en: A school can be proud of a garden and still admit who did the watering.
ex.zh: 学校可以为花园自豪，同时承认是谁浇的水。

tip: be proud of 后接名词或 doing。骄傲过头时 proud 含贬义，要看语境。

senses.en: money received from work or other sources

ex.en: Rent takes a large part of their income.
ex.zh: 房租占了他们收入的很大一部分。

ex.en: When food prices rise, low income leaves less money for books and clinic visits.
ex.zh: 食品涨价时，低收入会让书和看病的钱更少。

tip: income 可数或不可数都可以。

ex.en: Please use simple words in the notice.
ex.zh: 通知里请用简单的词。

ex.en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。

tip: simple 的副词是 simply。

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and lock the door?
ex.zh: 请帮个忙，把门锁上好吗？

ex.en: A favour for one class should not hide the bus from the others.
ex.zh: 给一个班的帮助，不应当把公交瞒着其他班。

col: do sb a favour｜帮某人一个忙
tip: favour 是英式，favor 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

ex.en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
ex.zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。

ex.en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
ex.zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。

tip: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

senses.en: the story of a book or film

ex.en: The plot is simple and the ending is not.
ex.zh: 情节简单，结局并不简单。

ex.en: A plot about a flood should not hide who had to leave their house.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的情节不应当藏起谁不得不离开自己的家。

tip: plot 也可指小块土地，或密谋。作动词是密谋或绘制。本条以故事情节为主。

senses.en: until now, often in questions and negatives

ex.en: She has not finished the poster yet.
ex.zh: 她还没有完成海报。

ex.en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
ex.zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。

tip: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

ex.en: She has faith in the team's hard work.
ex.zh: 她相信队伍的努力。

ex.en: Public rules should protect every faith without making one of them the school rule.
ex.zh: 公共规则应当保护每一种信仰，而不把其中一种变成校规。

tip: faith 可指对人的信任，也可指宗教信仰。

senses.en: the amount produced, or what a machine sends out

ex.en: The output of the garden is tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这个园子的产出是西红柿。

ex.en: Output numbers without a source are not a report.
ex.zh: 没有来源的产量数字不是报告。

tip: output 也可作动词“输出”。

ex.en: The underground station is closed.
ex.zh: 地铁站关了。

ex.en: An underground path still needs a light.
ex.zh: 地下通道仍然需要灯。

tip: 英式 the underground 可指地铁。ground 已在本库。

ex.en: She refused to hide the broken step.
ex.zh: 她拒绝把坏台阶藏起来。

ex.en: A school should refuse a drink ad that hides the sugar.
ex.zh: 学校应当拒绝隐瞒含糖量的饮料广告。

tip: refuse to do。名词垃圾也拼作 refuse，读 /ˈrefjuːs/，本条是动词。

ex.en: A lazy afternoon is not the same as a tired student.
ex.zh: 懒散的下午不等于一个疲惫的学生。

ex.en: Calling a classmate lazy ignores the student who works at night.
ex.zh: 说同学懒，会忽略那个晚上还在干活的学生。

tip: lazy 用在人身上会伤人。可以形容一段轻松的时间。

senses.en: a long metal weapon used in the past

ex.en: The sword is in the museum, behind glass.
ex.zh: 剑在博物馆的玻璃后面。

ex.en: A history chapter can show a sword and still not teach how to use one.
ex.zh: 历史课可以展示一把剑，同时仍然不教如何使用。

tip: 本条只作历史词汇。不写使用方法。

senses.en: a part of a tree, or a local office

ex.en: A branch fell across the path.
ex.zh: 一根树枝横在小路上。

ex.en: The library branch near the station stays open after the main one closes.
ex.zh: 车站附近的图书馆分馆，在总馆关门后还开着。

tip: branch 可指树枝、分公司、支部或学科分支。

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
ex.zh: 护士清理了伤口。

ex.en: A wound should be seen at the clinic, not hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 伤口应当去医务室看，而不是藏到周五。

tip: 名词伤口读 /wuːnd/。wind 的过去式 wound 读 /waʊnd/。本条是伤口，不写如何造成伤害。

ex.en: Take off your hat in the hall.
ex.zh: 在礼堂里摘下帽子。

ex.en: A hat in strong sun is a health tool, not only a fashion.
ex.zh: 烈日下的帽子是健康用具，而不只是打扮。

tip: hat 通常有边。cap 多指无边或只有前面有沿的帽子，本批另有词条。

ex.en: The worker locked the gate.
ex.zh: 工作人员锁了门。

ex.en: A night worker needs the late bus as much as a student does.
ex.zh: 上夜班的人需要晚班车，和学生一样。

tip: worker 可数。work 已在本库。

ex.en: The story uses terror, then it returns to the classroom.
ex.zh: 故事用了恐惧，然后回到教室。

ex.en: Terror in a headline is not the same as a fact.
ex.zh: 标题里的恐惧不等于事实。

tip: terror 通常不可数。本条不写如何恐吓。

senses.en: A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

ex.en: You may sit anywhere in the front two rows.
ex.zh: 前两排你可以随便坐。

ex.en: A student who cannot find anywhere quiet will not finish the same essay as a classmate with a desk.
ex.zh: 找不到安静地方的学生，完成不了和有书桌的同学同样的作文。

tip: anywhere 多用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句常用 somewhere。

senses.en: a piece of cloth used as a symbol

ex.en: The flag is raised at eight.
ex.zh: 旗在八点升起。

ex.en: A flag at the gate does not tell a new student where the clinic is.
ex.zh: 门口的旗告诉不了新生医务室在哪里。

tip: flag 作动词可以是标出或衰退。国旗前常用 the。

senses.en: to become someone's husband or wife

ex.en: They will marry in the spring.
ex.zh: 他们将在春天结婚。

ex.en: A form about who may marry should not shame the student who fills it in.
ex.zh: 关于谁可以结婚的表格，不应当让填写的学生感到羞耻。

tip: 名词 marriage 已在本库。不说 marry with。

senses.en: a wild animal, especially a large or dangerous one

ex.en: The story has a beast, not a pet.
ex.zh: 故事里有一只野兽，不是宠物。

ex.en: Calling a person a beast is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 把人叫做野兽，不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: beast 可数。用在人身上会伤人。

ex.en: She left a short comment under the article.
ex.zh: 她在文章下面留了一条短评。

ex.en: A rude comment online can follow a student longer than the lesson it interrupted.
ex.zh: 网上一句粗鲁的评论，可能比它打断的那节课跟学生更久。

tip: comment 作动词时，说 comment on something。

senses.en: the top layer of earth in which plants grow

ex.en: The soil here is good for tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这里的土壤适合种西红柿。

ex.en: Soil on a school path becomes mud when the drain is blocked.
ex.zh: 排水口堵住时，学校小路上的土会变成泥。

tip: soil 通常不可数。

senses.en: to do something that may cause harm

ex.en: There is a risk of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午有下雨的风险。

ex.en: The risk of flooding rises when a town builds houses on the cheapest land beside a river.
ex.zh: 当城镇把房子建在河边最便宜的地上时，洪水风险会上升。

tip: risk doing 表示冒险做可能带来坏结果的事。

senses.en: the space between two lines, or a way of looking

ex.en: Measure the angle before you cut.
ex.zh: 切割前先量角度。

ex.en: From the student angle, the last bus is the whole plan.
ex.zh: 从学生的角度看，末班车就是整个计划。

tip: angle 可数。

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。

ex.en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
ex.zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。

tip: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

senses.en: to plan a time for something

ex.en: The schedule is on the door.
ex.zh: 时间表在门上。

ex.en: A schedule that ignores the last bus will look neat and still fail.
ex.zh: 不考虑末班车的日程看起来整齐，仍然会失败。

tip: 英式常读 /ˈʃedjuːl/，美式常读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。作动词是安排。

senses.en: the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have

ex.en: Please keep the door closed.
ex.zh: 请让门保持关着。

ex.en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
ex.zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。

tip: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

senses.en: on the side opposite the right

senses.zh: 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）

ex.en: Turn left after the school gate.
ex.zh: 出校门后向左转。

ex.en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
ex.zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。

tip: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

senses.en: a person or thing that carries something

ex.en: The carrier on the bicycle is loose.
ex.zh: 自行车上的货架松了。

ex.en: A carrier of an illness should be able to stay home without shame.
ex.zh: 带病的人应当能待在家里，而不被羞辱。

tip: carrier 可数。健康课里可指带菌者。本条不写传播的做法。

ex.en: The user guide is on the desk.
ex.zh: 用户指南在桌子上。

ex.en: A library user who cannot log in still needs a way to borrow a book.
ex.zh: 登不进去的图书馆用户，仍然需要一种借书的办法。

tip: user 可数。计算机和图书馆都可以用。

ex.en: The visit included a moment of prayer for those who wanted it.
ex.zh: 参观包括片刻祈祷，给想参加的人。

ex.en: A school can explain prayer without telling every student to join.
ex.zh: 学校可以讲解祈祷，而不要求每个学生参加。

tip: 动词 pray 是本批的另一词。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: the area around a place; American spelling

ex.en: The neighborhood shares one clinic.
ex.zh: 这个街区共用一家诊所。

ex.en: A quiet neighborhood can still be far from the last bus.
ex.zh: 安静的街区仍然可能离末班车很远。

tip: neighborhood 是美式。英式是 neighbourhood。本库用考纲里的 neighborhood。
